interpolation: bilinear on projected LCC x/y axes (pyproj)
wind: sqrt(u10^2 + v10^2) from 10 m u/v components, m/s to km/h
lead_time_note: HRRR forecasts for the 00/06/12/18Z cycles only extend to f48. Leads 54/60/66/72 h are null by design in every file -- a known HRRR limitation, NOT missing data to backfill later.
acc_climatology: DOY + UTC-hour mean from 2025 station obs, ±15-day window
